info.name: AFG POS QA | TC_PM_02-47 | RUN PREFLIGHT FIXED V2
info.description:
28 physical TC_PM entries in master sheet rows 72-99, not a contiguous 46-case range. Safe E2E folder runs by default; persistent Menu CRUD folder is gated via qa_allow_persistent_menu_mutations=true. No menu delete/rollback verified; NEVER run menu opt-in on production. TC_PM_37 VOIDED lacks fixture; requires separate execution. Some PM_19/20/21 cases have partial coverage; do not claim full pass from assertions alone. Server contract not live-verified; initial run may surface genuine mismatches. Run only folder 01 or 02, NOT entire collection; 1 iteration. Secrets only in POS_STAGING Environment. TC_PM_37 conditional requires independent qa_voided_order_id; skipped is NOT pass.
FIX: TC_PM_34 STRICT 422 expectation retained, actual 400 recorded as contract discrepancy, run continues for cleanup. Folder 02 independently initializes supervisor/cashier/station. Gate emits visible FAIL+BLOCKED when opt-in not enabled (no silent skipping). Persistent menu records are NOT deleted; only run on disposable QA staging. Run folders separately.
V2: Folder 01 reports explicit BLOCKED_NO_AVAILABLE_TABLE and stops without manipulating active tables. Optional qa_preferred_table_id selects ONLY an AVAILABLE table. Folder 02 reports explicit BLOCKED_MENU_OPT_IN; enable opt-in only with authorization for persistent staging mutations. A blocked prerequisite is NOT a functional TC fail. TC_PM_34 preserves expected 422 vs actual 400 contract gap. Run each folder separately. Before rerun, inspect orphaned QA sessions from previous unfinished runs.
